title: Coccinelle
description: A cozy entomology universe for Minecraft — catch, collect, and sell.
body:
🐞 Coccinelle — A cozy entomology universe for Minecraft  
📖 ABOUT THIS MOD  
Coccinelle Mod brings a charming entomology experience to Minecraft. Explore your world, spot insects in the wild, catch them with a net, and fill up your collector's notebook.  

Every insect has its own rarity, size, price, and behavior. Some fly, some jump, some glow, some hide, and some only appear in specific biomes. The goal is simple: find them all, catch them all, and complete your collection like a true naturalist.  

The mod also adds an entomologist's table where you can sell your captured insects for emeralds.  

🐛 INSECTS TO DISCOVER  
Ladybug · Bee · Ant · Butterfly · Beetle · Dragonfly · Firefly · Praying Mantis · and more! (20 for now)  

✅ FEATURES  
- Many insects to discover and catch, each with unique behavior, rarity, and size  
- Entomologist's notebook with a full collection interface  
- Insect net for catching creatures in the wild  
- Entomologist's table to sell insects for emeralds  
- Variable sizes that affect the sell price  
- Custom 3D models and textures  
- Crafting recipes for all new items  

🔨 CRAFTING RECIPES

P B P

(I = Ink Sac, P = Paper, B = Book)
